question: AMBUSH is related to FPIWTH in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, LYPASE is related to QBWCTE. To which of the given options is OCTANE related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2670e84d57d8f3a0b32ba38d09d05a2c6cf49319e5d8eba39c7f1d3137f99525.png] 

The logic followed here is,

AMBUSH is related to FPIWTH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abdc82911dfb3fa01ac2a2653e6b91acf58b6954cfae8656e99f9291cecb2671.png] 

LYPASE is related to QBWCTE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec31278a734df27837ca077d9f846c72e1c1ac2e830be0c9bb95a19705d19b84.png] 

Similarly, OCTANE is related to TFACOE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e1715c3f55680ef3c499cc1dec920d66dcc6bc1e74656b296bc6a812e6ff516.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
